model: two-state Neel kinetic Monte Carlo, exact Stoner-Wohlfarth barriers and minima (moment tilt), dipolar interactions, exponential integrator with first-order hold, f0 = 1e9 s^-1, T = 310 K
verification_LRT: agreement within statistical error for d = 13-16 nm (sigma*h < 0.3); deviations for blocked particles where LRT is invalid

validation_DiCorato2014.params: d 10 nm, K 2.6e4, Ms 2.8e5 (their LRT fit), 700 kHz, 20 kA/m, no tuning
